skills.delivery_notes: Dual-pattern: horizontal dark red slashes forward (melee_arc) + orbit ring of slashes cycling around player. VS element-silent. No ailments named in dossier. Movement-speed damage bonus (caps at +40 flat) maps as resource/trait lane, not ailment.
Circle of slashes cycles around player simultaneously with frontal arc. Second geometry slot for the orbit component of the dual-pattern delivery.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Union of Vento Sacro + Bloody Tear — dual-pattern delivery confirmed. VS element-silent. Movement-speed damage bonus is the union's signature mechanic (inherited from Vento Sacro component). MOMENTUM_CASCADE T4 fits the continuous-movement damage ramp. Two-skill entry represents the dual geometry pattern.
